works.title: Easy Talk Communication System
works.description: A structured communication methodology being developed to bridge understanding gaps between users and their child with special needs. Creates a 'living lexicon' that maps signals/words to their intended meanings, with documented context, typical triggers, effective responses, repair strategies when communication misfires, and confidence levels for each entry. Designed as a practical tool for shared meaning-making.
works.quote: I've been finding his words—the words he attaches to meaning—and mapping them out against my own, I realized that nobody had really done this before

works.title: Geopolitical Analysis of Unprecedented Civilizational Disruption
works.description: An analytical framework examining three concurrent unprecedented disruptions unique to this historical moment: (1) technological disruption capable of restructuring the entire labor market through AI, (2) voluntary dismantling of the world order by the power that built and sustained it, and (3) a financial bubble of historic proportions built on fragile foundations. Analyzes how these overlapping crises create a qualitatively different geopolitical moment than any prior disruption.
works.quote: We have never before seen the simultaneous occurrence of: A technological disruption capable of restructuring the entire labor market
